Notes.Text:
This update for openssh fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-73281: refused binding requests on locked SSH agents can allow destination restriction bypasses
  (bsc#1275075).
- CVE-2026-73282: unsynchronized remote forwarding updates in SSH client multiplexing can cause use-after-free
  (bsc#1275074).
- CVE-2026-73283: unenforced restriction keywords on tunnel forwarding can allow administrative security policy bypasses
  (bsc#1275079).

Changes for openssh:
- Included mentions of the configuration drop-in directories (bsc#1259462).
